claims.text: The trip record and the GPS trace describe the same trip: both carry trip_id TRP-02804, the trace runs from the recorded pickup event at 2026-08-27T16:04:05+08:00 to the recorded dropoff event at 2026-08-27T16:42:05+08:00, and the fare breakdown is charged against the same trip. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore met on matching identifiers and timestamps.

The excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on the governing trace figure. The GPS trace measures 29.13 km against a booked optimal of 22.1 km, an excess of 7.03 km and 31.81% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass: 7.03 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold and 31.81% is greater than the 20% threshold. Under POL-RD-01 the governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 29.1 km, and the trace figure is the one cited here.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): it carries 229 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so there is no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The deviation may therefore be established on the trace alone, and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The driver's explanation is a bare traffic assertion and discharges nothing. His counterparty statement says only 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road', and it names no road, no segment and no advisory. Under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12; a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge that burden.

No traffic advisory is on file for this trip at all. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02804-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers the Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's traffic assertion cannot be tested against any advisory, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and the case does not escalate on that ground.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any part of the excess. The chat log for this trip contains zero messages, so there is no rider instruction recorded at all, and POL-RD-04 requires an instruction from the rider timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within 3 minutes after. With no chat message there is no waypoint_hint to test and the clause is simply unavailable; the excess is not reduced by it.

No pickup or dropoff relocation applies. The trip record shows original_pickup and original_dropoff both null, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. POL-RD-05 therefore cannot be run and the booked optimal of 22.1 km stands as the baseline for the excess.

The trip is not a pooled trip, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and the matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the booked optimal. The trip record records vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. The baseline for the threshold test is therefore the ordinary booked optimal of 22.1 km.

The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy and POL-RD-11 does not. The fare breakdown records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so the distance and time charges were not fixed at booking and the rider did lose money on the detour. The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary.

The POL-RD-02 recomputation runs on the fare breakdown's own constants and the surge multiplier recorded there. Charged_total is 45.82. Recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 22.1 + 0.28 x 29.8) x 1.2 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 ERP on the optimal route = (3.80 + 16.575 + 8.344) x 1.2 + 0.80 + 1.50 = 34.4628 + 2.30 = 36.7628. Refund = 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, giving 9.10. That is well above the 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 9.10.

The ERP line is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must not be added on top of it. The single gantry charged, PIE Eunos westbound at 1.50, is recorded as on_optimal_route true, and the recomputed fare above already includes it. Under POL-RD-09(1) off-route ERP is comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure and is itemised only for transparency; the off-optimal-route ERP total is 0.00, so there is no separate pass-through correction to make.

The driver's trailing-90-day record shows a repeat deviation pattern, which is a ground of decision under POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 329, so the ratio is 0.0030, below the 0.05 limb, and the count of 1 is below the 3-or-more limb. The pattern test therefore fails on the citable fields, and I do not ask for the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift or the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral on this record.

The rider's own profile does not trigger the extra corroboration requirement of POL-RD-08. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the 4-or-more threshold is not met and the claim does not need corroboration beyond the trace. I note for completeness that the rider's prior_no_show_flags and prior_disputes_filed are lifetime and context-only counters under POL-GEN-01 and I cite them for no purpose.

The rider's claim is supported by artifacts other than the GPS trace, which matters because the trace is the only artifact carrying the excess. The trip record independently records optimal_distance_km 22.1 and actual_distance_km 29.1 with deviation_pct 31.8, and the fare breakdown independently records distance_charged_km 29.1 and total_charged 45.82. The rider's account of a materially longer trip than quoted is therefore corroborated across three artifacts, not resting on the trace alone.

The rider's claim is not supported on the amount she contests. She contests 8.50, but the arithmetic under POL-RD-02 yields a refund of 9.10, and the contested amount is the ceiling on what a PARTIAL_REFUND can return to the filing party. I do not ask the tribunal to award more than the rider put in dispute; the refund is capped at the 8.50 contested.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver. The trip is a genuine route deviation and the rider is refunded SGD 9.10.

The evidence. The GPS trace for TRP-02804 (EV-GPS-02804) runs from the recorded pickup at 16:04:05 to the recorded drop-off at 16:42:05 on 27 August 2026 and measures 29.13 km. The booked optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02804) is 22.1 km. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs over the rounded 29.1 km copy on the trip record, so the excess is 7.03 km, or 31.81% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not material: 31.81% is below the 50% gate and 7.03 km is below the 8.0 km gate. The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) - 229 fixes at 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 s - so no independent corroboration is required.

No excuse applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02804) holds no messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run. The trip record shows no amended pickup or drop-off and no amended optimal distance, so POL-RD-05 does not apply; the vehicle is RYDE_X with no pooled itinerary, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's account (heavy traffic, another road) is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. No advisory is on file: EV-ADVIS-02804-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run, and an assertion citing no advisory and no evidence ID carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The traffic assertion is discarded, no advisory was on file, and the excess is not reduced.

The refund. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02804), so POL-RD-02 governs and the refund is arithmetic. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 22.1 + 0.28 x 29.8) x 1.2 surge, read from the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 ERP on the optimal route = 36.7628. Charged total = 45.82. Refund = 45.82 - 36.7628 = 9.0572, rounded up to SGD 9.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.10. The one ERP line (PIE Eunos westbound, SGD 1.50) is on the optimal route - the nearest trace fix is 35.32 m away, inside the 250 m radius - and is already inside the recomputed fare; under POL-RD-09(1) it is itemised for transparency and never added on top.

Points argued. The rider's submission that the refund is capped at the SGD 8.50 contested is rejected: no clause makes the amount in dispute a ceiling, and POL-RD-02 fixes the refund arithmetically at the SGD 9.10 the money block records as payable. The submission that the trip record and the fare ledger independently corroborate the distance is rejected in part: trip_record.actual_distance_km (29.1 km) and fare_breakdown.distance_charged_km (29.1 km) are rounded copies of the same trace measurement, not independent of it. Nothing turns on it, because the optimal distance (22.1 km) is independently set by the routing engine and every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at weight 1.0. The driver's submission calling the deviation 'material' is corrected above; its conclusion is right either way - deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1/329 (0.003) is below 0.05 - so POL-RD-06 gives no full-refund uplift and no conduct referral. No driver compensation is due: the billed 29.1 km falls short of the trace's 29.13 km by 0.03 km, far below the 1.0 km threshold in POL-RD-04. No billing-integrity correction is due under POL-RD-09(4): the gantry is matched to the trace and there is no airport surcharge.

Confidence and next steps. The deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02804, EV-TRIP-02804, EV-FARE-02804), so confidence is not capped below 1.0 and is set at 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: identifiers and timestamps agree, the trace is clean, no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited missing artifact, the refund is far below the SGD 150 ceiling and below charged_total, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. The monetary effect, SGD 9.10, exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the ruling issues and the amount is held for release by a human reviewer under POL-GEN-05. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.
